Name: Woodsman Hurst - An East Scarp Addon
Author: Sprinton
Description:
[left]Meet Hurst, a strange man in the Deep Mountains of East Scarp. Befriend him to learn more about him and the strange land he comes from, and the dark secrets he keeps close to his chest. And is that a small pomegranate trailing behind him? Enjoy the new dialogue, events, crops, items, locations, and more within this mod![/left]
[left]
[center][/center]
[/left]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45324/45324-1786866200-1410614594.png[/img][/center]

[left][center][/center]
[center][spoiler][u]Main Events

[/u][b]Introduction
[/b]Enter Cindersap after seeing the Wizard's event that lets you read Junimo on a sunny weekday. 
[b]2 Heart
[/b]Enter Hurst's Clearing after seeing his Introduction. Cannot trigger on Friday or Sunday.
[b]4 Heart
[/b]Enter Pierre's Shop after seeing his 2 heart. Cannot trigger on Friday or Sunday.
[b]5 Heart
[/b]Enter Hurst's Clearing after seeing his 4 heart in sunny weather. Cannot trigger on Friday or during winter.
[b]6 Heart
[/b]Enter Hurst's Clearing after seeing his 5 heart in rainy weather. Cannot trigger on Friday.
[b]7 Heart
[/b]Enter Deep Mountains after seeing his 6 Heart in sunny weather.
[b]8 Heart Part 1
[/b]Enter Hurst's Clearing after seeing his 7 Heart.
[b]8 Heart Part 2
[/b]Enter Hurst's Clearing after seeing his 8 Heart Part 1. 
[b]9 Heart
[/b]Enter the Mountain after seeing his 8 Heart Part 2.
[b]10 Heart
[/b]Enter Hurst's Clearing after seeing his 9 Heart and finishing the "Power the Spirit Walk" special order.
[u]Extra Events[/u]
Morris Fight
Enter the Town after purchasing a Joja Membership. Cannot trigger on Friday.[/spoiler]
[/center]
[/left]
[center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45324/45324-1786866223-818226069.png[/img]
[/center]
[center]Hurst can be dated, but not married. If you wish to romance Hurst, you must follow the requirements below.
[spoiler]Selecting a dialogue marked (ROMANTIC) in his 4 Heart or 8 Heart Part 1 will add a (ROMANTIC) dialogue to his 10H, selecting that will allow you to unlock Hurst as a romanceable character.

[u]Romance Events

[/u]Bath House Date
Enter the Bath House when dating Hurst. Cannot trigger on Friday.
Sick Day
Enter the JojaMart on Friday when dating Hurst. Cannot have seen the event where Morris gets run out of town.[/spoiler]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45324/45324-1786866228-962491267.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]

[b]
Hate:

[/center]

[left]He's on the far left of the Deep Mountains! There's a small sign and grass path marking the entrance.[/left]

[left][/left]

[/b]He's usually wandering around the valley! I suggest using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url] mod if you have struggle finding him![/left]
